info.title: Swarm public API
info.description:
The Swarm public API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_…` (a scoped API key from Settings → Developers) or an OAuth access token.

Every operation needs one scope, shown on it; a `:write` scope also grants its `:read`. A Channel the credential cannot reach answers 404.

Responses carry `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a 429 carries `Retry-After`. Writes accept `Idempotency-Key` (24 hours). Lists are paged with an opaque `cursor` and `limit` (up to 100). Errors are `{ error: { code, message, requestId, details? } }`.

bearerAuth.description: A scoped API key (sk_live_…) or an OAuth access token (oat_…). Scopes: channels:read, members:read, members:write, dispatches:read, dispatches:write, broadcasts:read, circles:read, circles:write, fields:read, fields:write, levels:read, forms:read, flows:read, flows:write, webhooks:read, webhooks:write, sends:read, sends:write, imports:read, imports:write, audit:read, rosters:read, rosters:write, goods:read.

encryptedUnavailable.description: True when this Member has encrypted profile fields that could not be decrypted just now (the key service did not answer): they read as null in `fields` this time, but still hold their values. Try again shortly. Absent otherwise.

emailsOffAt.description: When they chose “Stop emails, keep my membership” in their subscriber settings: posts and automation emails skip them, while receipts, sign-in links and billing notices still go. Their status and paid access are unchanged. Null: they receive emails.

encryptedUnavailable.description: True when this Member has encrypted profile fields that could not be decrypted just now (the key service did not answer): they read as null in `fields` this time, but still hold their values. Try again shortly. Absent otherwise.

plannedDate.description: The day a writer aims to send a draft, for the content calendar. It has no effect on sending.

importedAt.description: Set on an issue brought over from another platform. It stays on the website and can never be sent or scheduled.

bestTime.description: A scheduled send goes at each reader’s best time

html.description: Server render of the body, without personalisation

warnings.description: Lint results for the current render

htmlBlocksAllowed.description: Whether raw HTML blocks are enabled (the raw_html_mode flag)

unopenedOf.description: A resend: only people that Broadcast reached who neither opened nor clicked it get this one

internalNote.description: A note for the team. It goes in no email, page, feed or webhook

slug.description: Current web slug (/p/<slug>); created from the subject when first published

onSite.description: Published on the web and not hidden

webUrl.description: Canonical web address, once the Dispatch has a slug

DispatchDocument.description: Editor document. Node types: paragraph, heading, bulletList, orderedList, listItem, blockquote, horizontalRule, image, button, linkCard, hardBreak, gate (top level; what follows is the gated part), askPoll (top level; attrs askId and questionId of a choice question of this Channel: a one-tap poll), codeBlock (attrs.language: highlighted in email and on the web with the flag code_embeds), tableOfContents (flag code_embeds; top level; attrs.title?: lists the top-level headings, as links on the web), htmlBlock (flag raw_html_mode), smartBlock (flag smart_blocks; top level only, not nested: `{ type: "smartBlock", attrs: { condition: CircleRule, label?, anonymous: "hide" | "show" }, content: [blocks] }`, shown to the Members whose condition matches when the Broadcast starts, and on the web as `anonymous` says). snippet (flag snippets; top level only; attrs.snippetId: a snippet of this Channel, whose current content replaces the block when it renders. A send uses the snippet as it was when the send started; the website always uses the current one; a snippet that is gone renders nothing, with a warning). Any block may set attrs.showOn (flag block_visibility): "email" keeps it out of the website and site search, "web" keeps it out of the email, absent or null shows it on both, any other value is refused.

url.description: Null when the media item was deleted: the image is left out of the email and the website, with a warning

CoverImage.description: Shown above the body in the email and at the top of the web page

DispatchAudience.description: Who it goes to: Circles to include (everyone when empty) and to exclude

bestTime.description: Send at each reader’s best time, within 24 hours of the chosen time, worked out from when they opened or clicked before. Readers with too little history get the chosen time. Needs the best_time_send flag, and can’t run with a Split Test or Cohort Sample. Left out, a scheduled Dispatch keeps what it had.

limitedByWarmUp.description: Today’s warm-up limit couldn’t reach the whole audience, so everyone got the chosen time

bestTime.description: For a send asked to go at each reader’s best time; counted when the snapshot ends. Null otherwise.

value.description: Human opens, clicks or goal conversions

openRate.description: Human unique opens / delivered, leaving out emails sent untracked because the person asked

opens.description: The send had an open pixel per person

clicks.description: Links went through the tracker per person

untracked.description: Emails sent without a pixel or tracked links because the person asked not to be tracked

destination.description: Where a shortened link goes, when Swarm made it; null otherwise

clicks.description: Every click, scanners and bots too

Money.description: Mail provider cost at $0.10 per 1,000 messages

FlowRunCounts.description: Runs by status, test runs excluded

url.description: An https URL with a public host name

FeedSourceStatus.description: active: checked on its interval; paused: by a teammate; disabled: turned off after repeated failures (lastError says why)

post.summary: Add a Member, or update one with upsert
post.description: With `consent: true` (the person asked to receive this Channel) the Member starts active; otherwise pending, and they receive nothing until they confirm. Through an agent tool call, `consent: true` makes the Member active only when a person approved the call; otherwise the Member starts pending, and the consent record names the credential that asserted it. An address that is already a Member answers 409, unless `upsert` is true: then names and fields are updated, tags are added, and the answer is 200. An address erased through the Privacy Center is refused (409).

post.description: Renders a Template or a Dispatch for one Member of the Channel, fills `{{ var.name }}` from `variables`, and sends it at once. Suppressed addresses are never mailed: the send is recorded with status `suppressed`. `one_off` needs an active Member and carries List-Unsubscribe with One-Click; `transactional` carries no unsubscribe headers. Paid plans only; every accepted request counts against the daily limit. Scope `sends:write`.

post.description: Fetches the feed in this request, stores new items and makes the Dispatch its caps allow (an active `send` source schedules it to go out). Works on paused and turned-off sources too, without sending from them: a turned-off `draft` source that fetches is turned back on; a turned-off `send` source stays off and answers `resumeRequired: true`, and only resuming it (update with status active, which approval holds for agents) lets it send again. A failed fetch answers 200 with the error.
